archive.title: AFD (Attention-FFN disaggregation) architecture and SGLang merge-status review
archive.method: Read-only GitHub API/gh desktop review of issues, PRs, branch trees, file contents, reviews, timelines and releases. Not a source-code copy and not an AFD implementation.

question.text: 分析一下AFD分离架构，已经SGLang是否已经合入改功能：https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/45568

answer.summary: AFD is not merged into SGLang main. As of 2026-11-04 the main tree has no python/sglang/srt/afd directory, no --afd-role/--afd-backend server args and no AFD documentation. The complete implementation lives in unmerged PR #45562 (CONFLICTING) and the extracted first-step PR #45958 (CONFLICTING).
caveats: PR #36258 (NPU AFD experimental) is merged, but into vendor branch ifmn/npu/afd, not main, and is behind main by 4537 commits.
Component PRs DeepEP#14 and DeepGEMM#110 are both unmerged.
Performance numbers are author-reported and bound to specific measured revisions; not reproducible from main.

architecture.definition: Attention-FFN disaggregation places attention layers and routed MoE experts on separate GPU groups, so attention and expert capacity can be provisioned and scaled independently.

boundaries.attention_workers_A: request scheduling, KV cache, attention, routing, shared experts, residual processing, sampling; speculative draft execution stays on A
boundaries.ffn_workers_F: execute routed experts and return outputs; no generation scheduling, no KV cache
boundaries.startup_handshake: validate model, expert layout, quantization and topology; negotiate communication and graph capacities for asymmetric A/F groups; membership fixed at startup
boundaries.forward_coordination: agree execution mode, token shapes, active sessions and graph variants; staged backends batch compatible sessions on F, direct backends coordinate a common plan across A/F ranks
boundaries.model_integration: replace routed-expert execution with a remote call while preserving routing, shared-expert, scaling and residual semantics
